protocol: Direct reference evaluation at matched physical locations, epochs and input conditions. Every density is a fresh model call; no caching, interpolation, surrogate or trajectory precomputation is used.
geodetic_or_geocentric: grid points are geodetic; each model receives its own published latitude convention from the shared provider

frame_direction_check.rotation_direction_assumption: earth_fixed_rotation maps J2000 into the Earth-fixed frame; the inverse used here is its transpose

local_solar_time_note: reported as UTC + longitude/15 h for interpretation only; model local solar time comes from the shared provider
temperature_note: temperature_k is the temperature at the requested altitude; exospheric_temperature_k is the exospheric temperature. NRLMSISE-00 and JB2008 name these differently.
weather_inputs: immutable observed archive records; hashes in manifest.json
ratio_note: model-to-model differences are model-form differences, not evidence that either implementation is wrong
failure_policy: a compiled-in backend that fails aborts the run; only a build-time absent backend is reported here, and no model is ever substituted for it
